title: Extract Frames from MP4
cap_description: Decode the MP4 video track and emit each frame as a PNG image
documentation:
## Purpose

Decodes an MP4 video and emits its frames as a sequence of PNG images. With no `--fps` argument every decoded frame is emitted; with `--fps N`, frames are decimated to approximately `N` per second by selecting the first decoded frame whose presentation timestamp passes each `1/N`-second boundary.

## Inputs

- An MP4 file (path or stdin).
- An optional target frame rate (default: every frame).

## Outputs

A sequence of PNG images, one per emitted frame.

## Notes

- Decoding happens in-process via embedded ffmpeg static archives — no system ffmpeg dependency, no shell-out.
- Decoded frames are colour-converted to RGBA and re-encoded to PNG via the `image` crate; the byte stream is identical in shape to other `media:image;png` producers in the cap fabric (e.g. PDF page rendering), so downstream image consumers work without adjustment.
- For audio extraction from the same file, use [Extract Audio Track from MP4](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:extract-audio-track;in="media:mp4;video";out="media:m4a;audio").

args.arg_description: Path to the MP4 file to process
Target frames per second. Omit to emit every decoded frame.

output.output_description: PNG images, one per emitted frame
